profile.headline: Vice President; Software Engineer III at Bank of America Merrill Lynch
profile.summary:
I am currently based in New York at Bank of America Merrill Lynch.

Previously, I was part of Barclays Capital as a Software Developer for the internal Credit Derivatives Trade Capture application.

My initial role was working as a consultant for FDM Group, a world wide IT consultant firm aimed to helping new graduates and military veterans get their feet wet in the IT industry.

My passion with software development comes with the idea that I can wake up and be able to create and develop something that I can be proud of myself. A long term goal of mine comes from that idea and I would say that goal is to be a part of a development team that works towards some kind of product that thousands or maybe even millions of people use on a day-to-day basis.

positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: Assistant Vice President; Software Engineer III
Assistant Vice President; Programmer Prof MKTS
positions.description: Developer on the Equities Big Data Alerting and Analytics platform

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
* Credit Derivatives Trade Capture system dealing with both FO and MO which allowed me to learn about the whole trade lifecycle (e.g. initial booking, post trade, confirmations, clearing, external flows)
* Part of multiple core component rewrites across the stack
* Migrated to a lead UI developer role in 2016 taking ownership of developing and reviewing the code for multiple FAT C# desktop applications while working on our Java backend components in parallel
* Dealt with a lot of DevOps related tasks which includes an SCM migration to Git from Perforce and updating our build flows

positions.title: IT Consultant
positions.description: Consulted at various clients throughout the United States working on software related to financial services.

positions.title: Trainee
positions.description:
Involved an intensive four month training period that included Unix, SQL and Java

Unix
- Developed a script in VI that allowed a user to safely delete and restore a file or directory

SQL
- Played around with an Oracle database
- Created a trading schema from the knowledge that we gained in training
- Originally drew up ERDs to map out how the relationships were going to be before actually starting to code the DDL for the schema
- Given a final project that tested our understandings of SQL that involved seeing how efficient our joins, stored procedures, sequences and triggers were

Java
- Learned the importance of design patterns and the SOLID principles in an enterprise level application
- Developed a web trading platform that was designed to give us practice with the concepts of MVC
- Used the Spring API to deal with MVC, DI and automated logging
- With this platform, developed a CRUD interface that I used to integrate JDBC, JPA and Spring's version of JDBC into my project

positions.title: Application Developer - Consultant
positions.description: Developer for one of the Foreign Exchange applications that Bank of America owns.

positions.title: Software Developer - Consultant
positions.description:
2013 RBI Team Innovation Award

Worked with one of our Senior Developers to help develop an ETL system to transfer data from our legacy database to our new NoSQL database by hitting the RESTful URLs associated with each of the data sources. Primarily made use of libraries such as Restlet, Spring MVC, Hibernate and MarkLogic.
